name: Montana

rule.hpNote: motor rated at more than 10 hp (motorboat or PWC)
rule.textEn: Only youths aged 13 and 14 need it: to run a motorboat or PWC with a motor over 10 hp alone they must hold a boating safety certificate, unless someone 18 or older is aboard.
rule.textEs: Solo lo necesitan los jóvenes de 13 y 14 años: para manejar solos una lancha o moto acuática con motor de más de 10 hp deben tener un certificado de seguridad náutica, salvo que vaya a bordo alguien de 18 años o más.

minAge.note: Age 12 and under: no motorboat or PWC over 10 hp unless someone 18+ is aboard. Ages 13-14 alone need the certificate. No education rule from age 15.

exemptions: A NASBLA-approved course from another state or organization counts.

card.feeNote: The FWP home-study course and certificate are free; private online courses range from free to about $80.

nonResident: A NASBLA-approved course from another state or organization is accepted for 13- and 14-year-olds.
rental: You must be 18 or older to rent a motorboat or PWC with a motor over 10 hp.
penalty: General boating-law violations: fine up to $500 and up to six months in jail.

sources.quote: In Montana youths 13 and 14 years of age may operate a motorboat or a personal watercraft powered by a motor rated at more than 10 horsepower only if:
they are accompanied by someone 18 years of age or older.
they show evidence of completing another state or organization's NASBLA approved boating safety course
Persons 13 years of age or older who successfully complete the course will receive a Montana Motorboat Operator's Certificate. The homestudy course is available free of charge.
Complete the online course. Then take the certification exam online if you wish to receive your Montana Motorboat Operator's Certificate.

sources.publisher: Montana Fish, Wildlife & Parks, 2026 Montana Boating Laws
sources.quote: Children 12 years old or younger may not operate a motorboat or a personal watercraft (PWC) powered by a motor rated at more than 10 horsepower unless accompanied by someone 18 years of age or older.

sources.publisher: Montana Fish, Wildlife & Parks, 2026 Montana Boating Laws
sources.quote: A person must be 18 years or older to rent a motorboat or a PWC powered by a motor rated at more than 10 horsepower.

sources.publisher: Montana Fish, Wildlife & Parks, 2026 Montana Boating Laws
sources.quote: A person convicted of violating Montana’s boating laws or regulations may be fined up to $500 and sentenced for up to six months in jail.
